slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Cache Length in For Loops

When iterating an array or list, cache its length: `for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)`. Avoid calling `.Length` inside the condition if the count doesn't change (it's usually optimized, but caching is a good habit).
